mapper.sql:
FROM sys_user WHERE is_deleted = 0
AND username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{username}, '%')
AND real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{realName}, '%')
AND status = #{status}
mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.username, u.password, u.real_name, u.phone, u.resident_id, r.name AS resident_name, u.status, u.is_deleted, u.created_at, u.updated_at FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN resident r ON r.id = u.resident_id AND r.is_deleted = 0 WHERE u.username = #{username} AND u.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
